summary: Require --tls-cert/--tls-key for the MCP HTTP transport on any non-loopback --addr; loopback binds may stay plaintext.
reason: A second round of Greptile review on mvanhorn/printing-press-library PR #1794 found that the JULES_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN bearer credential added by jules-mcp-http-bearer-auth still crossed the network in plaintext on non-loopback binds, letting it be intercepted and replayed. Added TLS support and a hard refusal to serve HTTP without TLS unless the bind address is loopback-only.
validated_outcome: go build succeeded; manually verified a non-loopback --addr without --tls-cert/--tls-key refuses to start, and a loopback bind still serves plaintext with the bearer-token gate intact.
